month.m7_policy: produced by frequency and null bots (fixed legal universe)

duplasena.unit: contest (all its draws scored together) — 100 contests = 200 draws

trevos.m7_policy: produced by frequency and null bots (fixed legal universe)

club.m7_policy: NOT produced: no fixed legal universe at every horizon contest (never invented); tickets are PRIMARY_ONLY

code_identity.freeze_commit: the commit that adds this file; behaviour is enforced by the fingerprints, the revision is recorded on every receipt

decision.interim: descriptive only (observed vs exact expectation); no p-value before the game's horizon
decision.read: once per (league, game), when that game's 100 horizon contests have terminal states
decision.reading: NO_EXCESS_DEMONSTRATED is not evidence of fairness; EXCESS needs an independent replication cohort

horizon.missing_rule: a contest with no timely commitment stays in the horizon as MISSED; no replacement, no extension, no selective skipping
horizon.pre_go: any commitment before the GO receipt is PRE_GO_REHEARSAL and never M7 evidence
horizon.rule_change: a change of the game's pool, draw size or ticket contract ends the horizon at the last contest under the frozen rules
horizon.special_contests: included (same draw process), flagged, also reported apart
horizon.start_rule: first official contest of each game whose result did not exist when the CP6 GO receipt was published; consecutive contest numbers after it

isolation: M8 / M8.x / M9 never change this file, its generators or its policies; anything new is a new cohort with its own pre-registration and later start
kind: M7 Prospective Evidence League protocol: what will be committed, scored and decided. Not a result.

league_rules.ADAPTIVE: the declared Hedge policies only; state updates only after a verified official reveal, each a new immutable version with a receipt binding the previous state; the policy itself (experts, eta, rule) never changes
league_rules.FROZEN: every generator, parameter, seed and scoring rule is fixed by this file; tickets are recomputed from the official history before each target and must equal the committed bytes; no retraining, re-expression or replacement after the first target
league_rules.pooling: never: each league has its own families and report; a FROZEN vs ADAPTIVE contrast is descriptive only

metrics.not_used: simulated ROI or prize money as evidence; log loss (no probabilistic bot in cohort 1)
metrics.primary: per bot and game: S_same = sum over scored horizon contests of primary hits (all draws of the contest); exact null = n-fold convolution of the per-contest hit law (any past-only ticket, adaptive or frozen, has this law under the fair draw); one-sided
metrics.scored_contest: a contest is scored for a bot only with PROSPECTIVE_LIVE timing for that commitment (both checks; CP3 receipts)
secondary: paired per-contest difference of each bot vs its league's first negative control (descriptive, with its SD)
prize-tier counts: FULL_TICKET bots on the official tiers; PRIMARY_ONLY bots only on tiers that need no absent component
the M7-HYPOTHESES-v1 S_replay statistics, decided only by that file's rule

power_reading: the per-game minimum detectable mean lift at 80 % power (Bonferroni bound of each Holm family) is recorded per league and game; 100 contests detect only large effects (relative lift about 5 % in Lotofacil and Lotomania, 25-75 % in the small-ticket games)

preregistration.relation: referenced unchanged; its S_replay families stay separate from the cohort families below

publication: commitments are published under the CP3 publication contract (docs/M7_PUBLICATION_ANCHOR.md); the GO receipt names its identity
selection_criteria: rule-based producers that DrawLab can execute for every game without fitted parameters: two frequency modes and the three native temporal rules of the Theory Arena
the pre-registered generators of M7-HYPOTHESES-v1 in their games (same bytes as the hypotheses, a second declared statistic)
two seeded uniform negative controls per game in FROZEN and one adaptive negative control (Hedge over uniform experts) in ADAPTIVE

excluded from cohort 1: fitted models (logistic, pool champion, neural) — a prospective walk-forward artifact freeze exists only for v2 Lotofacil; they may join only as a NEW cohort with its own pre-registration and a later first target
excluded: M8 / M8.x / M9 research (signal injection, set-native or temporal deep models, optimizers, regulatory genome, other lotteries)
chosen after M2-M6 retrospective inspection (the hypotheses were selected as M6 extremes); no bot was chosen with any horizon data
